name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a file. Returns numbered lines for text files. Image files (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF, ICO) return the image content if the model supports vision, else a text description. offset/limit apply to text files only. When modifying a file, reading alone is not enough: follow up with edit_file after reading. For multi-file changes, read all named files first, then edit each.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-based, default: 1).

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read. Omit to read entire file.
